g.title: priva_gene_mechanism_hub
g.text: PriVA condition-specific gene history, query-variant mechanism, and what each consumer reads

g.title: cluster_step1
g.text: STEP 1 the query variant's own mechanism, scored 0 / 1 / 2

g.title: cluster_step23
g.text: STEPS 2 and 3 the gene's germline histories this mechanism reaches

g.title: cluster_step4
g.text: STEP 4 attach to the row; no variant is left without an inheritance

g.title: cluster_pvs1
g.text: PVS1 two independent questions, deliberately never mixed

g.title: hpo_src
g.text: gene -> condition, with inheritance, penetrance, onset

g.title: mondo
g.text: merge conditions sharing a MONDO identifier

g.title: deduce
g.text: condition is recessive AND states no mechanism

a.xlink:title: truncating or splice-frameshift, and NMD does not say escaping

g.title: strength
g.text: QUESTION 2 how convincing is THIS null variant?
decided from the consequence, not from any mechanism score:
truncating, does not escape decay ................ 4 Very Strong
truncating, escapes decay, intolerant domain ..... 3 Strong
truncating, escapes decay, >= 10% of protein ..... 3 Strong
truncating, escapes decay, < 10% of protein ..... 2 Moderate
splice frameshift, not last exon ................. 4 Very Strong
splice frameshift, escapes decay ................. 3 / 2 as above
splice-induced inframe deletion, inframe deletion reduced
5'UTR frameshift, start_lost with no alt start ... assigned

a.xlink:title: by HGVSp, then HGVSc, then normalized genomic allele

g.title: e_lof
g.text: the transcript is destroyed, so there is
no protein left to gain a function

a.xlink:title: LOFTEE HC or OS, VEP LOF, PriVA splice or 5'UTR LOF

g.title: e_exact
g.text: that mechanism = 2, the others forced to 0

g.title: e_pred
g.text: LOF = 2 when LOFTEE HC rescues it
LOF = 1 when the transcript may survive

g.title: q_pred_d
g.text: LOFTEE HC or OS, VEP LOF,

g.title: suppress
g.text: whatever the winner outranked is recorded,

g.title: match
g.text: keep histories whose mechanism the variant acts by

g.title: carried
g.text: each surviving history reduced to four facts,
+ x_linked kept separately, never folded in

g.title: lad1
g.text: the variant's own mechanism reached a history

g.title: lad2
g.text: every germline condition of the gene agrees on one
inheritance. Unanimity is what makes it safe

g.title: lad3
g.text: HPO states no inheritance at all. ClinGen

g.title: gate
g.text: QUESTION 1 is loss of function a disease mechanism OF THIS GENE?
ANY ONE of five gene-level sources opens the gate:
1 gene_lof_mechanism_history -- a CURATED LOF in the condition cache
2 a ClinVar pathogenic / likely-pathogenic variant at >= 2 stars
5 ClinGen haploinsufficiency 3, or 30 / 40 for a recessive phenotype

g.title: masks
g.text: 2 columns in, 15 boolean masks out, in two families:
what the GENE's history says, split by inheritance
there is deliberately NO family conjoining the two

g.title: withdraw
g.text: the only mechanism score PVS1 reads,
and it takes evidence away, never grants it

g.title: crits
g.text: BS1 BS2 BS4 PP1 BP5 BP2 / PM3
each decides for itself whether the gene's history
and this variant's effect line up

g.title: cv_set
g.text: ClinVar structures, because they are keyed differently:
amino-acid map, keyed on the protein consequence
every entry has an HGVSp, so a canonical splice-site
variant cannot appear in it at all
splice map, keyed on having an EXON or INTRON field
one strict test on both: CLNSIG tokenized and matched

g.title: gene_wide
g.text: GENE-WIDE CONSTRAINT, read ONLY by PVS1's gate
None of these says which condition a variant acts on, nor
by what mechanism, so none of them can create a history.
